Taiwan market sees panic selling: TSMC, MediaTek limit-down; Delta, Nanya Tech deep oversold. Financials resilient with trust buying. Memory, networking, AI themes crushed. Foreigners liquidating heavily across tech; trusts selectively accumulating. Key watch: RSI normalization, foreign flow reversal, and MA20 reclaims for sustainable bounce.

Taiwan equities cratered with semiconductors -8% and electronic components -9% leading declines as foreign investors dumped 434k shares in chips and 119k in components. Financials marginally positive but saw 238k foreign selling. Only food and cement showed resilience with foreign buying. Broad risk-off dominates.

Taiwan market broadly cold with semiconductor and electronic components leading declines. Foreign investors heavily selling tech while financials see mixed flows. Widespread oversold conditions but negative momentum persists across sectors.

Taiwan market shows sector rotation with financials defensive amid tech selloff. Foreign selling dominates semiconductors (-433K shares) while financials see mixed flows. AI supply chain names report record revenues but face technical breakdowns. Oversold conditions in select tech and financials may trigger relief rallies if institutional buying sustains.

Taiwan market mixed with tech heavyweights dragging while defensive names hold. Financials see foreign outflow offset by trust buying. Biotech and telecom show resilience. Petrochemicals under pressure despite capacity expansion news. AI server names oversold but fundamentals intact.

Taiwan market shows broad tech weakness with semiconductors and components leading declines amid heavy foreign selling; financials also pressured. Only defensive sectors like food, auto, cement show resilience with foreign buying. Overall sentiment cautious.

Taiwan equities face broad technical deterioration with semiconductor and electronics sectors leading declines; institutional divergence evident as foreign selling pressures memory and PCB names while investment trusts accumulate AI supply chain beneficiaries.

Semiconductors and electronics face heavy foreign selling, panels and shipping diverge with Evergreen strong but Yang Ming weak; financials see outflows while food and cement attract buyers. Overall cautious as AI-driven names correct despite fundamental strength.

Taiwan market under pressure with semiconductors and electronics leading declines; foreign selling heavy in tech, but selective buying in cement and financials; oversold conditions in several names offer bounce potential; watch for stabilization above key moving averages and foreign flow reversal for broader recovery.

Taiwan market shows broad weakness led by semiconductors and electronic components. Foreign investors net sell tech sectors while defensive names resilient. Oversold conditions appear but downtrends persist; caution warranted until breadth improves.

Taiwan market pressured as semiconductors and electronics lead declines; foreign selling dominates tech and ETFs. Food and auto sectors resilient. National team buying in ETFs noted. Oversold major indices may trigger technical rebound, but institutional distribution suggests caution.
